name: AI-Powered Freelance Opportunity Aggregator — Telegram Daily Digest

parameters.query:
SELECT
    e.id AS evaluation_id,
    o.id AS opportunity_id,

    o.source,
    o.title,
    o.url,
    o.budget_text,
    o.opportunity_type,
    o.employment_type,
    o.work_mode,
    o.location,

    e.decision,
    e.total_score,
    e.scope_status,
    e.scope_confidence,
    e.summary,
    e.strengths,
    e.skill_gaps,
    e.uncertainty

FROM public.opportunity_ai_evaluations e

JOIN public.opportunities o
    ON o.id = e.opportunity_id

LEFT JOIN public.opportunity_delivery_log d
    ON d.evaluation_id = e.id
    AND d.channel = 'telegram'

WHERE e.evaluation_version = 'v1.8'
  AND e.decision IN ('APPLY', 'REVIEW')
  AND d.id IS NULL

ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN e.decision = 'APPLY' THEN 1
        WHEN e.decision = 'REVIEW' THEN 2
        ELSE 3
    END,
    e.total_score DESC,
    e.evaluated_at DESC

LIMIT 10;

INSERT INTO public.opportunity_delivery_log (
    evaluation_id,
    opportunity_id,
    channel,
    decision_at_delivery,
    total_score_at_delivery
)
VALUES (
    $1,
    $2,
    'telegram',
    $3,
    $4
)
ON CONFLICT (evaluation_id, channel)
DO NOTHING
RETURNING *;
